name: m3t8
description: A fortnight of §2.4 village life (issue #53): four housed founding adults (two households, one house each) live fourteen 2400-tick days under the full production-style roster — movement, gather, construction, skills, needs, lifecycle, households, Mass, social, schedules, IAUS brain with leisure/rest-day windows — and NO commands are ever submitted. The week rolls Monday-first off the day index, so days 6 and 13 are §2.4 Sundays: work windows close (the kitchen keeps half-staffed as the essential surface), the brain weights leisure/home above marginal work, and — when the variant stamps the Church — the whole congregation books Morning Mass through the communal planner, taking the broad morale buff (Pious their extra weight) while pairwise bonds reinforce across co-attendees. The no-Church variant runs the identical fortnight as the control: no bookings, no blessings, plain leisure only. Traits are staged (Hedonist/Pious west, Industrious/Sociable east) so weekdays gather and craft, evenings socialize (tavern gold sinks, shrine worship, friend visits), and both Sundays tell the story. Fixture pins milestone digests every 600th tick (Relationship/SocialEvents/activity rows ride the digest like any other state) for BOTH variants, the sampled daily arc, semantic acceptance gates (Mass fires only with the Church, attendees boosted and bonded, gather/build assignments never appear on a Sunday, essential production stays capped-staffed), and doubles as the extended double-run determinism canary.
